latestVersion.changelog:
Free Editing Editor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export polished 1080p MP4 videos from raw clips (up to 500MB, formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM).
- Guided, text-based video editing: just describe what you want ("trim pauses, add transitions...").
- Cloud GPU-powered rendering — nothing to install locally.
- Automatic backend setup and free credits for quick video edits (no paid software required).
- Simple workflows: upload, instruct, export; supports batch and iterative editing.
- All standard export and session management actions included, with clear error handling.
